facts.fact: The Minister of Home Affairs and Internal Security tells the National Assembly that INRIS has been deployed in eleven districts (Choma, Livingstone, Mongu, Solwezi, Ndola, Mansa, Kasama, Chinsali, Chipata, Lusaka and Kabwe), with no total given; the statement is undated, so the document's published year is used.

The Minister states that in the eleven INRIS districts enrolment has commenced, including registration of births and issuance of birth certificates using the system; death certificates are named only as something INRIS is intended to issue; the statement is undated, so the document's published year is used.

The Minister describes INRIS as the national and civil registration management system of the Ministry of Home Affairs and Internal Security, run through the Department of National Registration, Passport and Citizenship; the statement is undated, so the document's published year is used.

The Minister puts the cost of the exercise (deployment to district offices, routine and mobile enrolment, card issuance) at K1,069,366,200 and says mobile enrolment will start when resources are made available, without naming the source of funds; the statement is undated, so the document's published year is used.

systems.owner: Ministry of Home Affairs and Internal Security, through the Department of National Registration, Passport and Citizenship
systems.tiers: deployed in eleven districts; deployment to district offices is planned; also enrols for biometric National Registration Cards and is to assign a national identity number at birth

systems.owner: Department of National Registration, Passport and Citizenship
systems.tiers: national since 1965; manual and paper-based, described as the current system

note: The date is uncertain: the capture's own header says no in-text date was found and the PDF's metadata date is 14 March 2022, so the eleven-district figure may describe 2022 rather than 2026. The statement does not say how or where the birth record is made within a district. Identity link: INRIS is to assign the national identity number at birth.
